does: Advances the loading screen's local progress: adds its count to ls::LoadingScreenManager+0x38 (LocalProgress, atomic) and tells the GameStateEventManager's listeners (OnTickLoad). Each loading state's Enter (Init, LoadModule, LoadSession, LoadLevel, UnloadLevel, UnloadSession) first sets the local total +0x30 from its own field +0x14.

evidence.says: Toolkit EoCClient.dll TickLoad calls ls::LoadingScreenManager::IncLocalProgress; macOS bg3_macos_x64+0x356DAF0 adds to manager+0x38 under LOCK; the states' Enter write manager+0x30 from this+0x14 (macOS)
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; a stored pair of the two builds joins that function to this one (a seed)
EoCClient.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by vtable
